tools.name: hokmah_analyze
tools.description:
Estimates the impact of a described code change on an imported public GitHub repository.
`repo_url` is https://github.com/<owner>/<repository> and `query` describes the change in plain
language; `branch` is accepted for compatibility, the analysis uses the history imported
from the default branch. R

tools.name: hokmah_connect_project
tools.description:
Imports a public GitHub repository so it can be analyzed: indexes its source files
(.py .js .ts .jsx .tsx .rs .go .java) and its latest commits (up to 500) from the default
branch into a dependency and change-history graph. `repo_url` is
https://github.com/<owner>/<repository>; `branch` is accepted

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "hokmah_analyze" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
